column1: # Pet tiers, stores and boss drops (owner 2026-09-30: "make 3 tiers of pets sort them by most unique and most common ... sell them in the
# donator store loyalty store and deadmanstore ... some pets need to be only dropped by their boss or monster variant").
# Owner answers 2026-09-30: tier 1 (most unique) -> Donator Shop, tier 2 -> Deadman Shop, tier 3 (most common) -> Loyalty Shop; a pet whose
# boss exists on this server is drop-only (never sold); prices proposed by the agent (StorePets.PRICES), owner adjusts.
# Tiers: 1 = raids, the Inferno / Fight Cave / Colosseum / Gauntlet, Desert Treasure II and the other endgame bosses, Nex and the 1/5,000
#            God Wars generals and Corporeal Beast; 2 = the other boss pets (Wilderness bosses, slayer bosses, Dagannoth Kings, KQ, KBD);
#        3 = skilling, minigame and collection-log pets and the low-level bosses (Giant Mole, Scurrius, skilling bosses).
# drop_npcs / drop_rate: this server's npc ids that roll the pet on a kill (the OSRS boss and its Deadman breach variant) and the OSRS
# Wiki rate 1/N (Pet page, 2026-09-30). Empty = sold in the tier's shop instead. A drop npc written id:rate has its own 1/N (N522:
# the Chaos Fanatic 15052 drops Pet chaos elemental at 1/1,000, the Chaos Elemental at 1/300).
